newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's TGS to invest more in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's TGS to invest more in 1997.

text.p: Argentina's gas transport company Transportadora de Gas del Sur will step up the pace of investments in 1997 from more than $100 million planned in 1996, it said in a survey published Tuesday.

"TGS plans investments of over $100 million in 1996, which should create a lot of jobs. In 1997 we plan investments even higher than 1996," TGS's Marketing Director K. George Wasaff told El Cronista newspaper in a major business survey.
"We believe the cost of financing these investments should stay unchanged," said Wasaff, recalling TGS' successful $150 million Yankee bond issue this year.
The company said the Tequila recession had not hit it hard in 1995 or 1996, but it did complain about tax measures that hiked up income tax and witholding tax on foreign loans.
"With a pace of investments of about $100 million a year, altering that tax has a significant impact," said Wasaff.
